io.milvus.bulkwriter.writer

Class ParquetFileWriter

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.writer.ParquetFileWriter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    FormatFileWriter

    public class ParquetFileWriter
extends Object
implements FormatFileWriter
    FormatFileWriter implementation that writes bulk-import data rows to a Parquet data file.

    The writer maps each field of the collection schema to the corresponding Parquet type and appends array, vector, and struct fields as nested Parquet groups. Data rows are buffered into row groups and flushed to the file on close().
